text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as the Arima Kinen and Special
Week's
matchup against Grass Wonder
draws near...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set aside some time to strategize by
studying
racing footage of Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We've rounded corner number four and
it's Grass
Wonder on the outside! Here
comes Grass
Wonder! Grass Wonder!
She did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...
choice_data_list: スぺ、どうしたんだ……？
スぺ、どうしたの……？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go for a run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week suddenly gets up and
rushes out of
the room!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is running laps around the
track
with a desperate look in her eyes,
almost as if
she's being chased.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she's already finished our scheduled
training
for the day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
choice_data_list: オーバーワークだ、スぺ！
オーバーワークだよ、スぺ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm not good enough yet. You gotta let
me run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without thinking, I step in front of
Special Week
to keep her from running.
choice_data_list: ダメだ！
ダメだよ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know that standing in front of
a
running Umamusume is like jumping in
front of
traffic!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna end up getting hurt if you
don't
move!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why not?!
choice_data_list: それでも、ここは通さない

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Trainer...
choice_data_list: 俺が君のトレーナーだからだ！
私が貴方のトレーナーだからだよ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... sob...
choice_data_list: 1人で抱え込まないで、ちゃんと話そう

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week collapses in a heap on the
track
and begins to cry for a while...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... I... I said some
horrible things
to you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's exactly what happened.
choice_data_list: グラスの走りを見て、焦ったのか？
グラスの走りを見て、焦ったの？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I always knew that Grass was a force to
be
reckoned with.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But actually watching the footage... It
made me
really realize that I'm about to
go head-to-head
with her...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Her speed, her stamina, the timing of
her moves...
When you look at it, it's all
so perfect...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And it made me realize that I'm no
match for her.
She'd wipe the floor with
me right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...How can you be so sure?
choice_data_list: 俺は、そうは思わない
私は、そうは思わない

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There are so many racers in the Twinkle
Series
who are faster, stronger, or more
talented than
me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh...
choice_data_list: でも俺が選んだのは君だ！
でも私が選んだのは貴方だよ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You've always... been by my side...
choice_data_list: 俺がずっと傍で見てきたのも君だ
私がずっと傍で見てきたのも貴方だよ

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: 『日本ダービー』、いい走りだった
『日本ダービー』、いい走りだったね

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: 『天皇賞（春）』だって素晴らしかった！
『天皇賞（春）』だって素晴らしかったよ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: だから、『有馬記念』だって大丈夫だ
だから、『有馬記念』だって大丈夫だよ

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...You really do believe in me, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...And you think that my dream can
become a
reality.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. You have. Hehehe.
choice_data_list: 最初からずっとな
最初からずっとね

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna call it a day. It's time to go
home, eat,
and sleep like a log.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And then I'll be able to give it my all
again
tomorrow! I'm gonna keep running,
until I become
the top Umamusume in all
of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's big smile still has the
same sparkle
as it did when I first met
her.
